title: Australian-Style Stir Fried Noodles
description: A simple and flavorful Chinese-inspired dish made with Australian beef, noodles, and exotic vegetables.
instructions: 1. Cook the noodles according to package instructions.
2. In a large wok or frying pan, heat the sesame oil to medium-high heat.
3. Add the Australian beef to the wok and stir-fry for 3-4 minutes.
4. Add the bell peppers and onions to the wok and stir-fry for another 2-3 minutes.
5. Add the cooked noodles to the wok and stir-fry for 1-2 minutes.
6. Season the noodles with rice vinegar (if using) and serve hot.
7. Garnish with sliced green onions and sesame seeds (optional).
